body:
Hi,

I could not find a simple implementation of an emoji picker for mini.nvim so I made one. I'm not sure it's optimal but it works well enough :) The emoji source and caching are the same as for [Snacks.nvim](https://github.com/folke/snacks.nvim?tab=readme-ov-file).

It works in insert and normal mode. The source is available [in my config](https://github.com/vandalt/dotfiles/blob/main/private_dot_config/nvim/lua/mini_pick_emoji.lua) or below. 

Here are example mappings for it:

```lua
nmap_leader("fe", function() require("mini_pick_emoji").pick() end, "Emoji")
imap("<C-.>", function() require("mini_pick_emoji").pick() end, "Emoji")
```

<details>

<summary>Click for the full module code</summary>

```lua
local M = {}

-- The emoji data is downloaded online and cached following snacks.nvim
local emoji_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muan/unicode-emoji-json/refs/heads/main/data-by-emoji.json"
local cache_file = vim.fn.stdpath("cache") .. "/mini-pick/emoji-v1.json"

local notify = function(message, level) vim.notify(message, level, { title = "Emoji picker" }) end

--- Normalize emoji data to flat tables
local normalize = function(data)
  local items = {}
  for emoji, info in pairs(data) do
    if type(emoji) == "string" and type(info) == "table" and type(info.name) == "string" then
      local group = type(info.group) == "string" and info.group or ""
      table.insert(items, {
        emoji = emoji,
        group = group,
        name = info.name,
        text = string.format("%s  %s", emoji, info.name),
      })
    end
  end
  table.sort(items, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
  return items
end

--- Read emoji cache
local read_cache = function()
  if vim.fn.filereadable(cache_file) == 0 then
    return nil
  end

  local ok, lines = pcall(vim.fn.readfile, cache_file)
  local items = ok and vim.json.decode(table.concat(lines, "\n")) or nil
  if items then
    return items
  end

  notify("Could not read cached emoji data; downloading a fresh copy.", vim.log.levels.WARN)
  return nil
end

--- Write emoji cache
local write_cache = function(items)
  vim.fn.mkdir(vim.fn.fnamemodify(cache_file, ":h"), "p")
  local ok, result = pcall(vim.fn.writefile, { vim.json.encode(items) }, cache_file)
  if ok and result == 0 then
    return true
  end

  notify("Could not write emoji cache: " .. cache_file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
  return false
end

--- Load and normalize emoji items
--- If the cache is not available, downloads emojis with curl
local load_items = function()
  -- If the cache exists and can be read, just load it
  -- It's already formatted properly
  local cached_items = read_cache()
  if cached_items then
    return cached_items
  end

  if vim.fn.executable("curl") == 0 then
    notify("curl is required to download emoji data.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
    return nil
  end

  notify("Downloading emoji data", vim.log.levels.INFO)
  local output = vim.fn.system({ "curl", "-fsSL", emoji_url })
  if vim.v.shell_error ~= 0 then
    notify("Could not download emoji data: " .. vim.trim(output), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
    return nil
  end

  local items = normalize(vim.json.decode(output))

  if not write_cache(items) then
    return nil
  end
  return items
end

-- Insert the emoji at cursor location
local insert_emoji = function(item, mode)
  local target = MiniPick.get_picker_state().windows.target
  local buf = vim.api.nvim_win_get_buf(target)

  local cursor = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(target)
  local row, col = cursor[1], cursor[2]
  local line = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buf, row - 1, row, false)[1]
  local insert_col = mode == "n" and col + (line == "" and 0 or 1) or col
  vim.api.nvim_buf_set_text(buf, row - 1, insert_col, row - 1, insert_col, { item.emoji })

  local cursor_col = mode == "n" and insert_col or insert_col + #item.emoji
  vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(target, { row, cursor_col })
end

--- The emoji picker
M.pick = function()
  local mode = vim.api.nvim_get_mode().mode
  local items = load_items()
  if not items then
    return
  end

  MiniPick.start({
    source = {
      choose = function(item) insert_emoji(item, mode) end,
      items = items,
      name = "Emoji",
    },
  })
end

return M
```

</details>

comment_data.body:
Thanks for sharing!

Didn't closely read the "load-write-read-cache" part (it does look there are more safeguards than necessary, though), but here is my main thought about the 'mini.pick' part. Executing a picker will return the picked item (or `nil` if nothing was picked). So I'd probably organize it as:
- A simpler picker that just returns the picked emoji (i.e. the `item.emoji` part), without the dedicated `source.choose` part.
- A single Insert mode expression mapping (`:h map-expression`) that returns the picked emoji. This takes care of "insert the text and move cursor" part.
- Either do not have a Normal mode mapping for this (I'd guess it is mostly relevant in Insert mode), accepting to have to enter Insert mode to insert an emoji. Or add one that reuses "return emoji" style of picker.

Hope this makes sense.

```lua
--- The emoji picker
M.pick = function()
  local mode = vim.api.nvim_get_mode().mode
  local items = load_items()
```

reply_data.body:
> Thanks for the feedback! I just tried to update a simpler picker and to use an expression mapping, but I got the error below.

Ah, indeed, my bad. I forgot that Neovim doesn't allow any buffer text edited. At it is needed to actually show text in a picker.

There are very hacky workarounds around that, but those are definitely do not belong in the user config. Maybe `MiniPick.start()` can overcome that... I'll take a look.
